F1.title: _warmup_engine dense path does not handle AttributeError on _data_matrix_jax or _dont_cares_jax
F1.verification: Commit fb8b891 adds hasattr(target, '_data_matrix_jax') and hasattr(target, '_dont_cares_jax') guards in _warmup_engine. When either is missing, the engine is skipped with a debug log and the signature is added to _WARMED_SIGNATURES. Confirmed locally: rt._warmup_engine(object(), 1) no longer raises AttributeError on the missing attributes (verified after forcing sys.path to friend_project to bypass the unrelated main-project _gpu_runtime module).

F2.title: TYPE_CHECKING import of GPUBacktestEngine is unused
F2.verification: The 'if TYPE_CHECKING: from ... import GPUBacktestEngine' block has been removed. AST inspection of friend_project/gpu_fuzzy_trader/_gpu_runtime.py confirms zero references to GPUBacktestEngine and zero references to TYPE_CHECKING in the file.

correctness.notes: Both F1 and F2 from round 1 are properly fixed in commit fb8b891. The _warmup_engine dense path now mirrors the defensive pattern from _warmup_signature (hasattr guards), so the signature function's defensive code is no longer dead. _warmup_engine now silently caches the signature for unsupported engines, which is correct: it avoids retrying on every call and prevents log spam. The dead TYPE_CHECKING import has been removed, so the file is now lean. The 8 friend_project tests still pass (PYTEST_LOW_MEMORY=1, 0.39s). Module imports cleanly from friend_project without pulling in the main project's phase2_sparse_encoding dependencies. VRAM/RAM tier logic verified against expected boundaries (vram=14 -> 128 for T4, vram=None -> min(config,32), ram<=13 -> 32, etc.).

edge_cases.notes: _warmup_engine correctly handles: engines without _inner (falls through to engine), engines without _data_matrix_jax or _dont_cares_jax (skip + cache signature), engines with k=0 (uses empty chrom matrix). _iter_warmup_targets handles CV facades (looks for _fold_engines) and plain engines (hasattr simulate_rule_batch). configure_phase2_gpu_runtime wraps warmup in try/except, so any warmup failure is non-fatal. resolve_phase2_gpu_batch_size handles env-var precedence, auto-flag override (via PHASE2_GPU_BATCH_SIZE_AUTO env), and combined VRAM/RAM caps (final = min(vram_cap, ram_cap) when ram_cap is set).

security.notes: No new attack surface. subprocess calls remain read-only nvidia-smi queries with 5s timeout and stderr to DEVNULL. JAX cache directory creation is gated by os.path.isdir('/content') or falls back to /tmp/jax_cache.

maintainability.notes: F1 inconsistency between _warmup_signature and _warmup_engine is now resolved — both functions use the same hasattr guard pattern. F2 dead import is removed. Module is clean: clear function docstrings, consistent logger.info/warning/debug levels, no unused imports. The dense-only path matches the friend_project scope (no sparse_encoding branch).

test_adequacy.notes: No new tests added in this round (the F1/F2 fixes were the only round-1 blockers; test coverage was noted as a concern but not a required finding). All 8 friend_project tests pass. F1 is now regression-safe: a unit test on _warmup_engine with a stub object would verify the hasattr guard. The 8 existing tests cover config, evaluator, and governor contracts but do not exercise the new GPU runtime module — adding unit tests for resolve_phase2_gpu_batch_size (env precedence, auto flag, tier boundaries) and is_colab_runtime() would still be valuable in a future task, but is not blocking this round.
